scope: Repository-local account-aware BillingService boundary, authenticated billing HTTP routes and first-party financial/payment/event callers

criteria.description: The billing tenant finding, bounded contract, owner and exclusions are recorded without promoting global ERP or financial settlement readiness.
criteria.limitations: The gate authorizes only the repository-local billing service/HTTP/caller account boundary.

criteria.description: BillingService exposes encounter/record reads and mutations without explicit account scope, while the durable repository already accepts account scope and authenticated routes omit it on several paths.
criteria.limitations: The finding is source evidence; implementation and fresh tests are required before a bounded result.

criteria.description: Focused RED contracts can prove two-account billing record/item isolation and authenticated route forwarding before implementation.
criteria.limitations: The RED contracts and implementation have not yet run.

gaps: The RED/GREEN implementation, caller migration, regression, quality and review evidence remain outstanding.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via fresh local residual scouting and completed delegated source scout
authority.scope: Repository-local account-aware BillingService boundary, authenticated billing HTTP routes and first-party financial/payment/event callers
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible BillingService account-scope changes, authenticated billing route forwarding, first-party caller updates and focused tests. Exclude schema, migrations, repository SQL redesign, settlement/cash redesign, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before any schema, migration, repository SQL, settlement/cash redesign, provider, credential, target, production, deployment, release or global ERP behavior change.

next_action: Write and run the focused two-account BillingService and authenticated billing-route RED contracts, then implement only the explicit account boundary and first-party caller updates.
revalidation_triggers: Changing billing schema, migrations or repository SQL
Expanding into cash/settlement redesign or another financial aggregate
Changing providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, release or global ERP promotion
